'''P4-99''' was an [[astromech droid]] in service to the [[Resistance]] during its [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] with the [[First Order]]. During the Resistance's [[Battle of Starkiller Base|attack]] on [[Starkiller Base]], P4-99 was in the [[Astromech socket|astromech slot]] of [[Sara Bel-Sun]]'s [[T-70 X-wing starfighter]]. During the battle, Bel-Sun and P4-99 were [[Death|killed]].<ref name="Poe Dameron 28" />
